title: SPLA/73/2014 of State Of Uttarakhand Vs Pahal Singh AND OTHERS

paras.text:
SPLA No. 73 of 2014
With
G.A. No. 39 of 2014
With
CRMA No. 648 of 2014
Hon'ble Alok Singh, J.
Hon'ble Servesh Kumar Gupta, J.

Mr. D.K. Sharma, Addl. Advocate
General for the State.
Mr. Ramji Srivastava, Advocate for the
respondents.
There is 27 days delay in filing the
appeal. Learned counsel for the respondents
has no serious objection if delay in filing the
appeal is condoned. Delay in filing the
appeal is condoned.
Delay condonation application No. 648
of 2014 is allowed.
Present appeal is preferred against the
judgment and order dated 09.01.2014, passed
by learned IVth Addl. Sessions Judge,
Haridwar in Session Trial No. 295 of 2006
(New Number 370 of 2013), whereby all the
accused/respondents were acquitted from the
offences punishable under Sections 147, 148,
307 read with 149, 302 read with 149, 323
read with 149 and 201 I.P.C.
 Heard Mr. D.K. Sharma, learned Addl.
Advocate General for the appellant, Mr.
Ramji Srivastava, Advocate for the
respondents and perused the record.
Leave to appeal is granted.
Admit the appeal.
L.C.R. be summoned.

After receipt of the L.C.R., paper book
be prepared and copy thereof be supplied to
the learned counsel for the parties as per
Rules.
. (Servesh Kumar Gupta, J.) (Alok Singh, J.)
 25.03.2015
Shiv
